[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 165
- Description: Agroverse chocolate-process reel — v1→v5 iteration, Gemini frame+grade QC, and camera-grade correction
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://www.instagram.com/reel/DgNAp8ihMM8/
  
  Details:
  PRODUCED: "Chocolate process" master reel — 13-beat cacao-to-bar process film, cut from the farm media archive (Oscar farm / Fazenda Santa Ana / Santos facility), delivered to Discord as a 720x1280 share copy and published to Instagram by Governor Gary Teh:
  https://www.instagram.com/reel/DgNAp8ihMM8/
  
  WHAT THE TIME WENT INTO (session a8209b9a63b1, 2026-11-26 07:40-11:50 UTC, 71 messages):
  
  1. Diagnosed a 12/12 QC failure. Gemini frame-level QC flagged every rendered segment as wrong. Root cause was NOT the off-by-one indexing first claimed: clip-level labels cannot represent a clip containing several process steps. Proof: oscar-bahia/IMG_2200 shows "harvest by pruning shears" at 0.49s and "pod cracked open" at 5.49s — one clip, two beats. Rebuilt the pipeline around window-level verification (sample many timestamps per clip, ask Gemini whether THIS frame shows THIS action).
  
  2. Re-indexed 836 archive clips at action level after abandoning clip-level labelling.
  
  3. Built and ran a keyword-narrowed candidate pool (470 labelled clips) and a strict-definition window scan across 98 timestamps to solve the two weakest beats: winnowing (beans poured into the machine / nibs coming out) and the fridge shot.
  
  4. Interpreted and applied four governor craft corrections: cacao pods growing on tree must open the film; a split-open pod is not necessarily cacao; pod crack-by-hand must follow clip-from-tree; winnowing must show the MACHINE (beans in, nibs out), not hand shelling.
  
  5. Resolved gate #6 (human-must-be-on-frame-0) with Governor Gary Teh's Option B: EXTEND the beat rather than reorder his spec. Proved with the repo's own _ProbeAdapter that the pods-on-tree clip is tier 4 / 0 faces (so v3 would have aborted after encoding all 13 segments) and found a face-bearing establishing shot (oscar-bahia/IMG_2189, tier 1) to prepend. Also corrected an earlier false claim that the probe only ever returns TIER_NONE/TIER_FACE — that was a bad test (calling build_probe raw with MP4 bytes), not a code defect.
  
  6. Grade correction round. Governed the drying and pod beats by having Gemini score bean/pod CONDITION, not just action. Confirmed the governor's read exactly: v4's drying clip graded "dark greyish-black, mottled with white mould and dirt" (bulk low grade). Swapped to santa-ana/IMG_8199 (clear brown gourmet grade, 3/3) and fazenda-santa-ana/IMG_8185 @2.4s (unblemished pods, 2/3 — third frame rejected for framing/resolution, not blemish).
  
  7. Full gate discipline on every render: 8 structural gates (caption overrun, brand/variant, language, human-on-frame-0, original audio preserved etc.), then Gemini window QC on the RENDERED segments before delivery. Final: 14/14 on substance, 1080x1920 master, 720x1280 delivery, 8.3 MB, 54.5s, audio -24.4 dB mean.
  
  SOP DECISIONS ARISING (to be recorded in the runbook):
  - Frame 0 must carry a human; EXTEND the beat with an establishing shot rather than reordering a governor's beat spec.
  - Winnowing/cracking beats must show the machine: beans in, nibs out.
  - Any "split open pod" must be verified as cacao.
  - Gemini window-sample QC is now mandatory before every delivery; sample windows, not whole clips.
  - QC prompt must score GRADE/CONDITION alongside action — gourmet vs bulk and blemished vs clean are invisible to every existing assertion.
  
  DEFECTS FOUND (queued for the QC/grade PRs, not yet filed):
  - reel_factory --out is treated as a DIRECTORY; passing a .mp4 path silently creates a folder and writes the master inside it.
  - Gemini replies truncate to empty text; an empty SEEN is indistinguishable from a real WRONG verdict, so QC must retry rather than report a failure.
  - The delivery tool advertises a 25 MB Discord cap that is actually ~10 MB.
  - reel_factory has no archive subcommand; archival is a generated-media-raw manifest operation.
  
  Time logged: 165 minutes of substantive on-task work within the 250-minute session span (07:40-11:50 UTC). Excludes passive render wait beyond active polling/monitoring.
  
- Contributor(s): Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 275.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
--------
